items.title: Research management data for REF and research quality
items.detail:
Lead: Nathan

Team members involved: Marie C, Kevin

ID: DTP1092

Description: HR Systems team supporting multiple deliverables under the research management data for REF and research quality project

Deadline: not set

Deadline type: Fixed - compulsory

Progress updates: 27/08/26 - SB and MC met with DRAM to discuss Data Warehouse restrictions. Ewan confirmed it was too complex to remove the data before it hits the data warehouse and that we would need to take responsibility for ensuring data doesn't enter any company 10 reporting. We reached a short term compromise with a longer term solution needing to be built in fabric.
07/08/26 - Change request 20020465 has been raised to detail all of the configuration required for the live release.
Organisation Structure: - We have set up the organisation structure in UOXU, it is also set up in UOXC but this environment is due to be cloned soon and we don't want UOXC being used for testing Co90. 
Bucket Post Setup - Bucket posts have been set up in UOXU. Nathan has manually set up a number of test/fake employee records in UOXU to allow integration testing to commence.
Integrations: - Crispin Muncaster is trying to coordinate testing with Guy Williams and David Hickman. The tester needs access to the staging environment and Azure platform to confirm that the expected test results are happening.
Data Warehouse - Simon and Marie C met with DRAM team and Alex Gray to discuss ensuring that company 90 data does not get moved into our current data warehouse schemas and has a separate area where the data will live with appropriate access controls to ensure its locked down and future proofed. - DRAM have been provided with logic which will determine which records can be considered as Company 10 in the first instance.
Guidance and Training: - Julie and Michelle have been approached regarding changes to guidance materials as a result of company 10 going live
Access Provisioning: - Anne Mortimer and Nick Chandler are currently undertaking PXD training with Julie's support and Nathan coordinating.
- Anne is being provisioned with people management admin access in UOXU. - Anne is getting sign off from all colleges that she can act as guardian of their data, once she has this confirmation we will officially set her up as guardian of Company 90.
- I've asked Asta about Nathan having two accounts for reporting purposes, one which only has access to Company 10 and one which only has access to Company 90, to help him to report on exactly what he needs for any given request without having to check parameters or edit data manually.
ESS Requirements: - Nathan has logged in as a test account and shown Anne and Nik what the standard ESS profile looks like to an end user. It is with them to decide if they are happy with this or if they want to make any tweaks as a separate college ESS profile.
30/07/26 - Issue with posts in resolved, there was an issue with the csv conversation from excel, so that's resolved in the base files. Interfaces have been adjusted to ensure no non company 10 data is passed downstream, currently being tested. Nathan has been able to manually load fake records into the system for testing purposes and has demo'd how it will look to an ESS user.
- ORCID requirements have been passed back to Kevin to take forward.
16/07/26 - Posts set up but issue with cost centres identified during testing - referred to AG for resolution.
03/07/26 - FA team are testing scenarios for the visibility of Company 10 records within Company 90, and how these appear downstream in the BizTalk integration with PXD. 
26/06/26 - Org Structure set up in UOXU, discussions have been had with research services about the options for structuring posts, interface investigation has taken begun, £10k quoted to implement. Discussions have been had with Ewan and Alex Gray around ensuring data is handled appropriately in the data warehouse.
12/06/26 - Proposal document written and with Marie C. Training on how to set up companies and link the structure taken place 12/06. 
 29/05/26 - Research Services have confirmed requirements in terms of hierarchy and reference data. Simon has completed the write up of the proposal and is waiting on a risk assessment from Crispin. Simon has lined up Conor O'Brien to lead a session on UAT config when he's back from leave.
13/05/26 - Org training session took place. Flexpoints volunteered to the project to pay for AG consultancy. Conor O'Brien working with us on our config. 
24/04/26 - Decision made on approach to ORCID - we will amend the existing tile and the audience based on a review undertaken by Research Services
27/02/26 - Project want the ORCID to go ahead but they want the college data to go ahead now. Project need to set out working and where it appears in the onboarding list. College data planning is complete.
20/02/26 - Green light to go ahead with the project
23/01/26 - Project board agreed to progress, we need to provide accurate costings as a next step.
28/11/2025 - Project to take proposal to board on 12th December
30/09/2025 - Simon and Sarah met with Marie to provide estimates for the effort and cost involved in onboarding college staff onto PeopleXD.
29/09/2025 - Nathan has advised that "we are done with the SSO business. Ive gone back to Martin Mcgovern with some extra lists to help him with snagging but he has been quiet for a bit now and i think he realises that the HR data side of things has played out". 
27/6/2025 - Nathan provided a list of staff missing their SSO from PeopleXD
2/4/2025 - Crispin asking about reporting on ROD titles directly from eRecruitment; HFRA won't need this data until YE2025 so currently paused.
25/10/24 - Outcomes and recommendations were published, much of which is now part of other DTP streams. Formally the "investigative assignment" stage has finished and we're moving into an "implementation" phase (Anne Mortimer)

Next steps: ====MULTI COMPANY DATA====
Data Loading
- Nathan has the person details…

12/06/26 - Proposal document written and with Marie C. Training on how to set up companies and link the structure taken place 12/06. 
 29/05/26 - Research Services have confirmed requirements in terms of hierarchy and reference data. Simon has completed the write up of the proposal and is waiting on a risk assessment from Crispin. Simon has lined up Conor O'Brien to lead a session on UAT config when he's back from leave.
13/05/26 - Org training session took place. Flexpoints volunteered to the project to pay for AG consultancy. Conor O'Brien working with us on our config. 
24/04/26 - Decision made on approach to ORCID - we will amend the existing tile and the audience based on a review undertaken by Research Services
27/02/26 - Project want the ORCID to go ahead but they want the college data to go ahead now. Project need to set out working and where it appears in the onboarding list. College data planning is complete.
20/02/26 - Green light to go ahead with the project
23/01/26 - Project board agreed to progress, we need to provide accurate costings as a next step.
28/11/2025 - Project to take proposal to board on 12th December
30/09/2025 - Simon and Sarah met with Marie to provide estimates for the effort and cost involved in onboarding college staff onto PeopleXD.
29/09/2025 - Nathan has advised that "we are done with the SSO business. Ive gone back to Martin Mcgovern with some extra lists to help him with snagging but he has been quiet for a bit now and i think he realises that the HR data side of things has played out". 
27/6/2025 - Nathan provided a list of staff missing their SSO from PeopleXD
2/4/2025 - Crispin asking about reporting on ROD titles directly from eRecruitment; HFRA won't need this data until YE2025 so currently paused.
25/10/24 - Outcomes and recommendations were published, much of which is now part of other DTP streams. Formally the "investigative assignment" stage has finished and we're moving into an "implementation" phase (Anne Mortimer)
